mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and enhanced liquidity conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS declining over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as financial conditions tighten.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate earnings growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), payroll employment growth exceeding 200k monthly signals strong labor market conditions supporting corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE < 4.0% periods, PAYEMS > 200k fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 102.0 for two consecutive months signals robust manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of INDPRO > 102.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.5% for three consecutive months triggers expectations of prolonged monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as real rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) increasing by >0.2 percentage points from prior month signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of UNRATE >0.2pp increase instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as manufacturing and construction sectors weaken.
failure_condition: Joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
